stories.subject: Blueface Santa Clarita arrest
stories.summary: Blueface was arrested after a false Santa Clarita gun call; authorities said the incident was a bogus swatting call and alleged he delayed the investigation.

stories.subject: Jay-Z Super Bowl LXI report
stories.summary: Puck reported that Jay-Z selected himself for the 2027 Super Bowl halftime show; TMZ repeated the report and noted no official announcement.

stories.subject: Swae Lee Miami estate sale
stories.summary: Swae Lee sold his seven-bedroom South Miami estate for $4.35 million after asking $5.395 million; the property includes a 15-car garage and sports courts.

stories.subject: K. Michelle Jesus & Whiskey
stories.summary: K. Michelle released her debut country album Jesus & Whiskey; she said a late R&B song missed the nine-track project as the Nashville crossover took shape.

stories.subject: Justice original score for GTA VI
stories.summary: Rockstar confirmed Justice as GTA VI's original-score composers and released Flower in a Hurricane ahead of the Nov. 19 launch.

note: Every story was checked against at least two current reputable or primary sources. The Jay-Z item is explicitly qualified as a report without an official NFL announcement.
